items.source: resourceBasePath - the resource path to the root directory of the web application
items.translation: resourceBasePath - 指向 Web 应用程序根目录的资源路径

items.source: Determine if the supplied object is equal to this WebMergedContextConfiguration instance by comparing both objects' locations, annotated classes, context initializer classes, active profiles, resource base paths, property source descriptors, property source properties, context customizers, parents, and the fully qualified names of their ContextLoaders.
items.translation: 通过比较两个对象的 locations、annotated classes、context initializer classes、active profiles、resource base paths、property source descriptors、property source properties、context customizers、parents 以及它们的 ContextLoaders 的完全限定名，来确定提供的对象是否等于此 WebMergedContextConfiguration 实例。

items.source: Provide a String representation of the test class, locations, annotated classes, context initializer classes, active profiles, property source descriptors, property source properties, context customizers, resource base path, the name of the ContextLoader, and the parent configuration.
items.translation: 提供测试类的 String 表示形式、locations、annotated classes、context initializer classes、active profiles、property source descriptors、property source properties、context customizers、resource base path、ContextLoader 的名称以及 parent configuration。

items.source: Get the resource path to the root directory of the web application for the test class, configured via @WebAppConfiguration.
items.translation: 获取通过 `@WebAppConfiguration` 配置的测试类`test class`的 Web 应用程序根目录的资源路径。

items.source: Generate a unique hash code for all properties of this WebMergedContextConfiguration excluding the test class.
items.translation: 为此 `WebMergedContextConfiguration` 的所有属性生成一个唯一的哈希码，但排除 测试类。

items.translation: contextInitializerClasses - 合并后的上下文初始化类

items.source: activeProfiles - the merged active bean definition profiles
items.translation: activeProfiles - 合并后的活动 Bean 定义配置文件

items.source: cacheAwareContextLoaderDelegate - a cache-aware context loader delegate with which to retrieve the parent context
items.translation: cacheAwareContextLoaderDelegate - 一个用于获取父上下文的缓存感知上下文加载器委托。

items.source: If a null value is supplied for locations, classes, activeProfiles, propertySourceLocations, or propertySourceProperties an empty array will be stored instead. If a null value is supplied for contextInitializerClasses or contextCustomizers, an empty set will be stored instead. If an empty value is supplied for the resourceBasePath an empty string will be used. Furthermore, active profiles will be sorted, and duplicate profiles will be removed.
items.translation: 如果为 `locations`、`classes`、`activeProfiles`、`propertySourceLocations` 或 `propertySourceProperties` 提供 `null` 值，将存储一个空数组。如果为 `contextInitializerClasses` 或 `contextCustomizers` 提供 `null` 值，将存储一个空集。如果为 `resourceBasePath` 提供 空 值，则使用空字符串。此外，将对活动配置文件进行排序并删除重复项。

items.source: WebMergedContextConfiguration extends the contract of MergedContextConfiguration by adding support for the resource base path configured via @WebAppConfiguration. This allows the ContextCache to properly cache the corresponding WebApplicationContext that was loaded using properties of this WebMergedContextConfiguration.
items.translation: WebMergedContextConfiguration 扩展了MergedContextConfiguration的契约，通过添加对由 @WebAppConfiguration 配置的资源基础路径的支持。这使得ContextCache能够正确缓存使用此WebMergedContextConfiguration的属性加载的相应WebApplicationContext。

items.source: If a null value is supplied for locations, classes, activeProfiles, propertySourceLocations, or propertySourceProperties an empty array will be stored instead. If a null value is supplied for the contextInitializerClasses an empty set will be stored instead. If an empty value is supplied for the resourceBasePath an empty string will be used. Furthermore, active profiles will be sorted, and duplicate profiles will be removed.
items.translation: 如果为 `locations`、`classes`、`activeProfiles`、`propertySourceLocations` 或 `propertySourceProperties` 提供 `null` 值，将存储一个空数组。如果为 `contextInitializerClasses` 提供 `null` 值，将存储一个空集。如果为 `resourceBasePath` 提供 空 值，则使用空字符串。此外，将对活动配置文件进行排序并移除重复的配置文件。

items.source: If an empty value is supplied for the resourceBasePath an empty string will be used.
items.translation: 如果为 `resourceBasePath` 提供空值，将使用空字符串。
